method.criterion: Strict source-local support for subject and object boundaries, relation, polarity, modality, and condition. A literal caption assertion is counted supported even if another passage contradicts it; the contradiction is reported separately.
method.gold_criterion: Semantic match to reviewed abstract biological gold claims; no string-exact predicate requirement. Focused fixture in_scope flags identify 19 biological claims. Methods procedure claims reported separately.
method.biology_focus_criterion: Count source-supported biological mechanisms, functions, expression/prognostic associations, cell-line phenotypes, and molecular properties as in focus. Exclude routine assay designs and steps, animal handling, figure presentation, reporting/reagent/institutional metadata, and generic clinical background unrelated to molecular biology. This is a separate relevance judgment, not a precision judgment.
